headlines.title: Microsoft Scrambles to Find Fix Massive Global Outage
headlines.description: Workplaces, government agencies and schools around the globe were thrown into chaos after Microsoft’s servers went down Thursday afternoon. The massive outage is impacting the entire Microsoft suite of products including Outlook, Teams, Copilot and SharePoint. NBC’s Christine Romans reports for TODAY on the tech giant’s struggle to find a fix.

headlines.title: Van Hollen Challenges Schumer for Senate Majority Leader
headlines.description: Maryland Sen. Chris Van Hollen announced Thursday he will run for Senate majority leader, becoming the first to challenge Sen. Chuck Schumer for the position. NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Democrat Cindy Holscher defeats Republican Ty Masterson in Kansas governor’s race
headlines.description: Democratic state Sen. Cindy Holscher has narrowly won Kansas’ race for governor, NBC News projected Thursday, extending the party’s hold on the office in the red state.

headlines.title: First video of Brooklyn building collapse
headlines.description: New video shows the moment catastrophe struck in Brooklyn. As the death toll rises, we speak with families who lost loved ones and learn about amazing stories of survival. NBC News’ Sam Brock reports.

headlines.description: Pope Leo XIV made a triumphant return to the Peruvian city of Chiclayo, where he served as bishop for and was affectionately nicknamed “Padre Roberto.”

headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.
